name: httpserver
description: Turn a DuckDB process into an HTTP OLAP API server. POST a query, get JSON results back. Basic-auth or X-API-Key authentication, an embedded Play SQL UI, and zero-config startup. Run DuckDB read-only behind it for safe shared access.

cta.title: DuckDB as an HTTP API
cta.description: Install httpserver to expose a DuckDB instance over HTTP — auth, multi-user, embedded query UI, no extra infrastructure.
